curatedMovie.curiosityHook: Can platonic partners raise a child together without letting outside dating expose the unspoken feelings between them?
curatedMovie.description: After watching their circle get consumed by marriage and parenting, longtime pals Julie and Jason decide to have a baby together as platonic co-parents, preserving their freedom until romance enters the picture.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: A funny, emotionally grounded romantic comedy balanced by heartfelt relationship drama, ideal for dates or casual nights with friends.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Jennifer Westfeldt directs a sharp, warm romantic dramedy exploring whether friends can successfully untangle parenthood from romance without emotional fallout.
